text_description: A dark, tailored skirt suit look centered on a fitted black tweed-style jacket worn over a plain black underlayer, paired with a matching high-waisted pencil skirt. The jacket has a collarless round neckline edged with textured/frayed trim, strong narrow shoulders, long straight sleeves, and a close-cut waist that opens slightly at the lower front to reveal the black layer beneath. The front is decorated with bright metallic round buttons placed down the center and near the lower pockets, with small flap-like pocket details at the hips; scattered reflective sequins or bead-like flecks are embedded across the fabric, catching light irregularly. Gold safety-pin-like embellishments sit symmetrically near both upper shoulders, adding a punk-jewelry accent to the otherwise polished tailoring. The skirt continues the same black textured, subtly striped tweed surface with scattered sparkle, fitting closely through the hips and extending below the cropped frame. Styling includes long dangling earrings, visible pink/red textured hair at the sides, and a small gold object or chain held low in one hand, creating a refined runway mood with structured tailoring, dark sparkle, and decorative metallic accents.
